plan.title: docs(security,installer): install-trust pattern — no naked curl|sh as blessed path

narratives.Description: Add install-trust pattern: prefer package managers/pinned artifacts/checksums; pipe installers are break-glass with human confirm; agents must not download-and-execute from untrusted articles. Cross-link installer/security guidance. Closes #2969.
narratives.Overview: Industry curl|sh default must not be Directive's blessed path.
narratives.UserStory: As an agent writing install guidance, I want an explicit install-trust pattern, so that I do not present naked curl|sh as Directive primary install advice.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: Step 1: Create content/patterns/install-trust.md file forbidding naked curl|sh as primary install. Step 2: Update content/coding/security.md to link the pattern. Step 3: Update content/skills/deft-directive-article-review/SKILL.md security block so agents reject download-and-execute installers. Step 4: CHANGELOG.md cites #2969. Verify by reading committed files and link targets. drive-to: merge-ready. Closes #2969. CHANGELOG.md may be edited last with unique Unreleased bullets (shared non-exclusive).

narrative.Acceptance: When the PR merges, content/patterns/install-trust.md exists and rejects naked curl|sh as the primary blessed install path.
Given content/coding/security.md is opened, it records a link to the install-trust pattern file.
When article-review skill security section is read, it rejects download-and-execute of installers from untrusted article content.
When CHANGELOG.md is opened, it records an Unreleased entry that cites #2969.
